answer.reason: Both serve restaurant meals to consumers and offer franchising. Wendy’s focuses on burgers, breakfast and drive-thru/delivery convenience; ONE Group emphasizes steak, sushi, cocktails and chef-led dining entertainment. Shared restaurant demand supports adjacency, but the offerings and dining occasions differ.
answer.missing_evidence: The passages do not establish close overlap in customer segments or dining occasions.

citations.text: For more than four decades, Samurai has provided a distinctive dining experience. Our skilled personal chefs masterfully perform the ancient art of teppanyaki right before your eyes. The air fills with the sizzle of razor-sharp blades slicing through tender steak, juicy chicken, and savory vegetables—all prepared right at your table. Our sushi chefs artfully prepare a wide variety of signature sushi and sashimi, using only hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. If you’re looking for something to quench your thirst, we feature a diverse array of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and sake. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, a promotion, or simply enjoying a meal, Samurai is the perfect restaurant for any occasion.

citations.label: C:P3.6
citations.text: At Benihana, we celebrate what each guest brings to the table. Whether it’s your family, friends, appetites, or enthusiasm, we’re here to transform every meal into a memorable experience. Our skilled teppanyaki chefs prepare your meal right before your eyes. Our USDA Choice steaks are aged to perfection, and our sauces, salad dressings, and crisp vegetables are all made from scratch. Our sushi chefs expertly craft a diverse selection of signature sushi and sashimi using hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. And if you’re thirsty, explore our variety of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and of course, sake. Beyond food, we’re passionate about entertaining you.
